# Iraq OpenSourceRail Campaign
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-marketing-campaigns.py. -->

National outreach package covering **18 catalogued cities**. Values
below aggregate city screening models; the national brief separately treats the
shared manufacturing plant.

## Audience

- Iraq ministry responsible for transport and urban mobility
- Iraq national climate, energy or Green Climate Fund authority
- Iraq public investment, planning or finance authority
- Embassy or High Commission of Iraq in the United Kingdom — economic section

## National proposition

| Measure | Catalogue result |
|---|---:|
| Population represented | 29,491,199 |
| Lines / route length | 78 / 2,274 km |
| Fleet | 3,603 trainsets |
| City programme CAPEX | $20.46 B |
| Local capital and value allocation | $15.42 B (75%) |
| Station/depot PV / storage | 291.6 MW / 1647.0 MWh |
| Illustrative external-capital saving | $31.79 B |

Lead with a government-reviewed pilot, local manufacturing and construction,
open standards, renewable-energy integration and independently checked demand,
environmental, social and engineering studies.
